document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Lucky888 was developed as a Bathala simulation twin for mathematical analysis and game design evaluation. The prototype reconstructs the reference game’s observable 6×5-reel structure, symbol set, tumble mechanic, Bathala elimination skill, Scatter behaviour, Free Game behaviour, and multiplier system. Gameplay rules that can be directly verified through observation have been reproduced as closely as possible. However, as the underlying probabilities and gameplay parameters cannot be directly verified, the simulation twin uses configurable datasets (JSON & CSV files) that can be easily imported, adjusted, and exported out via the HTML5-based workbench.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧Lucky888 是一套用于数学分析与游戏设计评估的 Bathala 游戏模拟模型。该原型重构了参考游戏中可观察的 6×5 转轴结构、符号组、连消机制、Bathala 符号消除技能、SCATTER 机制、免费游戏机制及倍数系统。可通过观察直接验证的玩法规则均已尽可能忠实复现；对于无法直接验证的底层概率与玩法参数，模拟模型采用可配置数据集（JSON & CSV 文件），可通过 HTML5 工作台便捷地导入、调整和导出。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧⟦R5⟧⟦/R5⟧⟦R6⟧⟦/R6⟧⟦R7⟧⟦/R7⟧⟦R8⟧⟦/R8⟧⟦R9⟧⟦/R9⟧⟦R10⟧⟦/R10⟧⟦R11⟧⟦/R11⟧⟦R12⟧⟦/R12⟧⟦R13⟧⟦/R13⟧⟦R14⟧⟦/R14⟧⟦R15⟧⟦/R15⟧⟦R16⟧⟦/R16⟧⟦R17⟧⟦/R17⟧⟦R18⟧⟦/R18⟧⟦R19⟧⟦/R19⟧⟦R20⟧⟦/R20⟧⟦R21⟧⟦/R21⟧⟦R22⟧⟦/R22⟧⟦R23⟧⟦/R23⟧⟦R24⟧⟦/R24⟧⟦R25⟧⟦/R25⟧⟦R26⟧⟦/R26⟧⟦R27⟧⟦/R27⟧⟦R28⟧⟦/R28⟧⟦R29⟧⟦/R29⟧⟦R30⟧⟦/R30⟧⟦R31⟧⟦/R31⟧⟦R32⟧⟦/R32⟧⟦R33⟧⟦/R33⟧⟦R34⟧⟦/R34⟧⟦R35⟧⟦/R35⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: The simulation twin’s development involved four key stages: Observation, Reconstruction, Simulation, and Appraisal. These development steps crystallized into 2 final outputs:
A playable simulation prototype with tools to track, input, and export session-based configuration inputs and spin outcomes · http://lucky888.ludoai.xyz/

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: A dashboard with file upload functions and structured reporting · http://lucky888.ludoai.xyz/dashboard/
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧支持文件上传与结构化报告的数学分析仪表板 · ⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧http://lucky888.ludoai.xyz/dashboard/⟦/R3⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Specific rules, mechanics and hidden parameters such as the minimum number of matching symbols required for a win were directly replicated from observable gameplay.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧具体规则、机制及隐藏参数（例如构成中奖所需的最少相同符号数）均直接依据可观察玩法进行复现。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧⟦R5⟧⟦/R5⟧⟦R6⟧⟦/R6⟧⟦R7⟧⟦/R7⟧⟦R8⟧⟦/R8⟧⟦R9⟧⟦/R9⟧⟦R10⟧⟦/R10⟧⟦R11⟧⟦/R11⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Values such as internal symbol probabilities, exact feature-entry weights, and multiplier probabilities cannot be verified simply by observing the game. All parameters that cannot be verified have still been implemented with easily modifiable weights for iterative testing.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧内部符号概率、奖励功能进入权重及倍数概率等数值无法仅通过观察游戏加以验证。所有不可验证的参数均采用易于调整的权重配置，以支持迭代测试。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧⟦R5⟧⟦/R5⟧⟦R6⟧⟦/R6⟧⟦R7⟧⟦/R7⟧⟦R8⟧⟦/R8⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Reel mechanics specific to the Bathala Slot machine game were carefully observed before replication. This is crucial because the game does not use paylines and instead relies on tumbling logic.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧复现前，我们对 Bathala 老虎机游戏特有的转轴机制进行了细致观察。这一点至关重要，因为游戏不采用赔付线，而是以连消逻辑判定中奖。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧⟦R5⟧⟦/R5⟧⟦R6⟧⟦/R6⟧⟦R7⟧⟦/R7⟧⟦R8⟧⟦/R8⟧⟦R9⟧⟦/R9⟧⟦R10⟧⟦/R10⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: After a win, winning symbols are removed. Remaining symbols fall into place, and new symbols drop in from above.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧中奖后，中奖符号会被移除。其余符号下落补位，新符号从上方落入。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: The grid is then checked again for another win. Tumbles continue until no new win is formed.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧随后重新检测盘面是否形成新的中奖组合。连消持续进行，直至不再产生新中奖。⟦/R0⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: After each winning Tumble, one Low Pay Symbol (L1 to L5) is selected and removed from the reels.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧每次中奖连消后，会选取一个低赔符号（L1 至 L5）并将其从转轴中移除。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Removal does not award a payout by itself.
Remaining symbols fall into place, new symbols drop in, and the next Tumble is evaluated.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧其余符号下落补位，新符号落入，随后结算下一轮连消。⟦/R0⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Scatter Symbols pay anywhere on the reel.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧SCATTER 符号可在转轴任意位置形成赔付。⟦/R0⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Landing ≥4 Scatters in the Base Game awards 15 Free Spins.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧基础游戏中出现 ≥4 个 SCATTER 时，奖励 15 次免费旋转。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧⟦R5⟧⟦/R5⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Note: Scatter Symbols are evaluated after all Tumbles have finished.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧注意：所有连消结束后才结算 SCATTER 符号。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Landing ≥4 Scatters in the Base Game awards 15 Free Spins.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧基础游戏中出现 ≥4 个 SCATTER 时，奖励 15 次免费旋转。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧⟦R5⟧⟦/R5⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Landing ≥3 Scatters during Free Spins awards 5 additional Free Spins.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧免费旋转期间出现 ≥3 个 SCATTER 时，额外奖励 5 次免费旋转。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧⟦R5⟧⟦/R5⟧⟦R6⟧⟦/R6⟧⟦R7⟧⟦/R7⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Multipliers collected from winning Tumbles are added together and carried forward for the remainder of the Free Spins feature.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧中奖连消中收集的倍数会累加，并在本次免费游戏的后续免费旋转中持续生效。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: When a winning Tumble contains one or more Multiplier Symbols, their values are added together and applied to the win.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧若中奖连消中出现一个或多个倍数符号，其倍数值将累加后应用于本次中奖。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: During Free Spins, collected multipliers are added to the current feature multiplier and accumulate into subsequent tumbles.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧免费旋转期间，收集到的倍数会叠加至当前免费游戏倍数，并延续到后续连消。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Note: Multiplier Symbols are collected only when they appear on a winning Tumble.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧注意：倍数符号仅在其出现在中奖连消中时才会被收集。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Observable gameplay was translated into a simulation engine that could reproduce Spin behaviours.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧将可观察玩法转化为能够复现 Spin 行为的模拟引擎。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧⟦R5⟧⟦/R5⟧⟦R6⟧⟦/R6⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: The simulation engine was designed to trigger the known reel logic: symbol generation, win evaluation, multiplier handling, symbol eliminations, symbol refill, Scatter evaluation, and Free Game resolution.
TUMBLE WIN: (L4 X 8) with x4 MULTIPLIER
The simulation prototype updates session metrics in real-time whilst allowing each spin’s inputs and outputs to be inspected independently.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧模拟原型实时更新会话指标，同时支持逐次检查每个 Spin 的输入与输出。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Betting configs, feature configs, symbol weights and paytables can be modified, imported, tested and exported on a per session basis.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧投注配置、奖励功能配置、符号权重和赔付表均可按会话修改、导入、测试和导出。⟦/R0⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: To evaluate the game’s mathematical profile, a standalone Monte Carlo simulation script was developed to generate large volumes of synthetic spin data.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧为评估游戏的数学配置，我们开发了独立的蒙特卡洛模拟脚本，用于生成大量合成 Spin 数据。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧⟦R5⟧⟦/R5⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Deterministic random seeds allow results to be reproduced and validated at-scale, thereby providing greater confidence in the observed RTP, volatility, win rate, and feature performance.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧确定性随机种子支持大规模复现和验证结果，从而提升观测 RTP、波动性、中奖频率及奖励功能表现的统计可信度。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧⟦R5⟧⟦/R5⟧⟦R6⟧⟦/R6⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: In order for the simulation data to be successfully evaluated, a math dashboard with a file ingestion pipeline was created to process the aggregated Spin data (JSON or CSV) into performance metrics.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧为有效评估模拟数据，我们构建了带文件导入流程的数学分析仪表板，将汇总 Spin 数据（JSON 或 CSV）转换为表现指标。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧⟦R5⟧⟦/R5⟧⟦R6⟧⟦/R6⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Winning Spin Frequency (≈1 winning outcome per 3.2 paid spins)
Multiplier Payout as share of Credited RTP
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧倍数赔付占实际计入 RTP 的比例⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: The default configuration produced an overall RTP of 93.15%, which means the game operates within a commercially plausible range. However, how that return is distributed between ordinary wins, multipliers, Scatters, and Free Games matter more for user engagement and monetization.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧默认配置的整体 RTP 为 93.15%，处于商业上合理的区间。但对玩家参与度和商业化表现而言，更关键的是回报如何分布在普通中奖、倍数、SCATTER 与免费游戏之间。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧⟦R5⟧⟦/R5⟧⟦R6⟧⟦/R6⟧⟦R7⟧⟦/R7⟧⟦R8⟧⟦/R8⟧⟦R9⟧⟦/R9⟧⟦R10⟧⟦/R10⟧⟦R11⟧⟦/R11⟧⟦R12⟧⟦/R12⟧⟦R13⟧⟦/R13⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Winning Spin Frequency: 31.31% (≈1 in 3.2 paid spins)

The default configuration provides relatively frequent positive feedback despite the game’s high-volatility profile. The result suggests that volatility is being generated less through low hit frequency, and more through substantial variation in the size of winning outcomes.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧尽管游戏呈现高波动特征，默认配置仍能提供相对频繁的正向反馈。这说明其波动性并非主要来自低命中频率，而是来自中奖金额的显著差异。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧⟦R5⟧⟦/R5⟧⟦R6⟧⟦/R6⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Free Games contribute approximately 29% of the game’s total RTP. So, while the majority of RTP still comes from the Base Game, the feature is large enough to influence the player's overall risk-and-reward experience.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧免费游戏贡献约 29% 的总 RTP。虽然大部分 RTP 仍来自基础游戏，但该奖励功能的贡献已足以显著影响玩家整体的风险回报体验。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧⟦R5⟧⟦/R5⟧⟦R6⟧⟦/R6⟧⟦R7⟧⟦/R7⟧⟦R8⟧⟦/R8⟧⟦R9⟧⟦/R9⟧⟦R10⟧⟦/R10⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Multiplier RTP Contribution: 49.60% (or 53.24% of Credited RTP)
Multipliers are the single largest source of returned value in the current configuration.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧当前配置中，倍数是最大的单一 RTP 贡献来源。⟦/R0⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: This makes the game a multiplier-led experience where relatively small changes to multiplier frequency and payout weighting can substantially alter RTP and volatility.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧因此，当前游戏属于倍数主导型数学配置；倍数出现频率或赔付权重的微小变化，都可能显著改变 RTP 与波动性。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧⟦R5⟧⟦/R5⟧⟦R6⟧⟦/R6⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Free Game Multiplier RTP: 22.97% (out of 27.03% Feature RTP)

Approximately 85% of Free Game RTP is generated by multiplier uplift. This indicates that Free Game is fundamentally an accumulation and multiplier-led feature, rather than a feature driven by additional spins and regular wins.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧约 85% 的免费游戏 RTP 来自倍数增益。这表明免费游戏本质上是累积倍数主导型奖励功能，而不是主要依靠额外免费旋转和普通中奖驱动。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧⟦R5⟧⟦/R5⟧⟦R6⟧⟦/R6⟧⟦R7⟧⟦/R7⟧⟦R8⟧⟦/R8⟧⟦R9⟧⟦/R9⟧⟦R10⟧⟦/R10⟧⟦R11⟧⟦/R11⟧⟦R12⟧⟦/R12⟧⟦R13⟧⟦/R13⟧⟦R14⟧⟦/R14⟧⟦R15⟧⟦/R15⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Base Game Multiplier RTP: 26.63% (out of 66.12% Base Game RTP)

Multipliers are not only important during Free Games. They account for roughly 40.2% of Base Game return as well. This means multiplier behaviour affects the entire game economy rather than functioning solely as a bonus-feature enhancement.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧倍数并非只在免费游戏中重要，其同样贡献约 40.2% 的基础游戏回报。这意味着倍数机制影响整个游戏经济，而不仅是奖励功能的强化手段。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧⟦R5⟧⟦/R5⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Multipliers appear relatively infrequently yet generate half of total RTP, demonstrating how leveraged the mechanic is. Basically, whenever multipliers interact with winning combinations and tumbles, they produce a disproportionately large payout effect.
Mean Multiplier vs. Summed Multiplier vs. Maximum Observed : 6.60x vs. 8.44x vs. 522x
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧平均倍数 vs. 累计倍数 vs. 观测最大累计倍数：6.60x vs. 8.44x vs. 522x⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: At 6.60x, most multiplier interactions seem to occur at relatively modest values.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧平均倍数为 6.60x，说明大多数倍数事件仍集中在相对适中的区间。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: However, the large gap between the average and maximum observed summed multiplier is characteristic of a design where multiplier events provide constant engagement while rare combinations create headline win potential.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧但平均累计倍数与观测最大累计倍数差距巨大，反映出该设计通过常规倍数事件维持参与度，同时由罕见组合提供高额中奖潜力。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Approximately 4 in 10 symbol eliminations result in the refilled board immediately producing a winning combination.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧约每 10 次符号消除中有 4 次会使补充后的盘面立即形成新的中奖组合。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: This observation confirms that the elimination effect is not merely a visual event but is in fact a continuation mechanic by virtue of regularly extending winning sequences.
Elimination Activations: 56.74% (≈1.95 symbols eliminated per paid spin)
The elimination effect changes the reel composition frequently, allowing for more variance.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧符号消除会频繁改变盘面符号构成，从而提高后续结果的变化程度。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧⟦R5⟧⟦/R5⟧⟦R6⟧⟦/R6⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Even when elimination does not immediately create another win, the mechanic boosts the number of refills and winning frequency, making it a core mechanic rather than a bonus event.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧即使消除没有立即形成新中奖，该机制仍会增加符号补充次数和中奖频率，因此属于核心玩法机制，而非偶发奖励事件。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧⟦R5⟧⟦/R5⟧⟦R6⟧⟦/R6⟧⟦R7⟧⟦/R7⟧⟦R8⟧⟦/R8⟧⟦R9⟧⟦/R9⟧⟦R10⟧⟦/R10⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: While roughly 1/3 of paid spins produce a tumble, the average tumble sequence remains relatively short. These sequences serve to provide continuation without long cascades dominating gameplay.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧约 1/3 的付费 Spin 会触发连消，但平均连消序列仍相对较短。此类序列为玩法提供延续感，同时避免长连消过度主导核心体验。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧⟦R5⟧⟦/R5⟧⟦R6⟧⟦/R6⟧⟦R7⟧⟦/R7⟧⟦R8⟧⟦/R8⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Regardless, the maximum observed tumble depth of 10 indicates that players do occasionally encounter extended sequences.
Base Game Tumble vs. Free Game Tumble: 30.98% vs. 27.77%
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧基础游戏 vs. 免费游戏连消触发频率：30.98% vs. 27.77%⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Free Games do not appear to derive more RTP from either deeper or more frequent tumbles.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧免费游戏并未通过更深或更频繁的连消获得更多 RTP。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Instead, the feature's additional RTP is primarily generated through the accumulating multiplier mechanic. This is useful because it clearly separates the role of the two mechanics: tumbles provide cadence, while multipliers provide feature and payout escalation.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧相反，免费游戏的额外 RTP 主要来自累计倍数机制。这清晰区分了两项机制的作用：连消负责节奏与延续，倍数负责放大奖励功能价值和赔付。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧⟦R5⟧⟦/R5⟧⟦R6⟧⟦/R6⟧⟦R7⟧⟦/R7⟧⟦R8⟧⟦/R8⟧⟦R9⟧⟦/R9⟧⟦R10⟧⟦/R10⟧⟦R11⟧⟦/R11⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Payout Tail: 10× 1 in 68 paid spins (or 1 in 21 winning spins)
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧赔付尾部：10× 约每 68 次付费 Spin 出现 1 次（或每 21 次中奖 Spin 出现 1 次）⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧⟦R5⟧⟦/R5⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: 95% of winning spins remain below 10×, while ≥100× outcomes represent only about 0.34% of winning spins.
Moreover, only 34 out of 1 million paid spins triggered ≥500× outcomes.
This means that ordinary wins serve to maintain session activity and user engagement, while the most memorable wins remain genuinely coveted.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧这意味着普通中奖用于维持会话活跃度和玩家参与度，而真正高额且令人印象深刻的中奖仍保持稀缺。⟦/R0⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Mean Win per Paid Spin vs. SD vs. CoV: 0.932 vs. 8.85 vs. 9.5
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧每次付费 Spin 平均中奖 vs. SD vs. CoV：0.932 vs. 8.85 vs. 9.5⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: The contrast between the mean win and a standard of deviation of 8.85 suggests that individual outcomes vary widely around the average.
document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧平均中奖与 8.85 的标准差形成鲜明对比，说明单次结果相对均值高度离散。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0000.tr.0001.tc.0.source: Since SD is approximately 9.5 times the mean RTP, a large proportion of RTP is concentrated on a handful of very high value wins rather than being distributed evenly. Therefore, this volatility profile is considered high.

document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.source: The current default setup in the simulation twin is a multiplier-led profile. In this setup, whilst some players will get to see more extravagant wins, the typical player will often only see outcomes around the average. This is further confirmed by a CoV of 9.5.
document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧当前游戏模拟模型采用倍数主导型数学配置。在该配置下，少数玩家可能遇到高额中奖，但大多数玩家通常只会看到接近均值的结果。CoV 为 9.5 进一步印证了这一点。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.source: From a qualitative experience standpoint, the 2 screenshots on the right show Spins #68 and #55 accumulate several multipliers, spiking session RTP to 225% and volatility to a staggering 7.69.

One reason why the multipliers were able to accumulate so quickly was because of 3 feature activations within 68 spins. Typically, this would be a very rare occurrence because the default config triggers 1 feature approximately every 120 paid spins.
document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧倍数能够快速累积的原因之一，是在 68 次 Spin 内触发了 3 次奖励功能。此情况通常极为罕见，因为默认配置约每 120 次付费 Spin 才触发 1 次奖励功能。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧⟦R5⟧⟦/R5⟧⟦R6⟧⟦/R6⟧⟦R7⟧⟦/R7⟧⟦R8⟧⟦/R8⟧⟦R9⟧⟦/R9⟧⟦R10⟧⟦/R10⟧⟦R11⟧⟦/R11⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.source: Upon closer analysis of the exported CSV, over 80% of the session's total returns came from just 4 specific spins:
document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧进一步分析导出的 CSV 后发现，该会话 80% 以上的总回报仅来自 4 次特定 Spin：⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.source: For a Slot machine and RMG operator, such variance is unsustainable.
document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧对老虎机及 RMG 运营商而言，这种方差水平不可持续。⟦/R0⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.source: One way to resolve the volatility spikes is to replace the existing multiplier-led math profile with a tumble-led math profile, where engagement and RTP are primarily derived from symbol eliminations, longer tumble sequences, and medium-sized wins.
The main KPI target is to reduce CoV to between ~4.5 and 6.
document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧主要 KPI 目标是将 CoV 降至 ~4.5 至 6 之间。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.source: More frequent with slightly larger wins
To achieve this proposed profile, there are 4 key areas that must be tuned:
document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧要实现建议的数学配置，必须调优以下 4 个关键领域：⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.source: Move concentration from High Multipliers to Low Multipliers
document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧将权重集中点从高倍数转向低倍数⟦/R0⟧
⟦R0⟧将权重集中于低赔符号分布⟦/R0⟧
⟦R0⟧将权重集中于高价值符号（高赔符号）⟦/R0⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.source: Dampen the payout cliffs observed in High-Symbols, while raising the overall payouts for Low-Symbols
document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧平滑高赔符号的赔付断层，同时提高低赔符号的整体赔付⟦/R0⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.source: Firstly, the multiplier distribution is very dispersed and requires radical tuning. A mean multiplier of 4.5× should be the hard cap, while multiplier SD should be below 3×. This change requires dampening the existing lottery mechanic and turning it into a progression amplifier. The two tables below illustrate the scale and impact of the new configuration.
document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧首先，当前倍数分布离散程度很高，需要大幅调优。平均倍数应以 4.5× 为硬上限，倍数 SD 则应低于 3×。这需要削弱现有的彩票式机制，将倍数转化为玩法进程的放大器。下方两张表展示新配置的调整幅度及预期影响。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧⟦R5⟧⟦/R5⟧⟦R6⟧⟦/R6⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.source: While 100×, 250× and 500× have been made redundant, lower volatility does not mean more boring gameplay. The changes to the multiplier curve simply replaced volatility with event frequency.
So, while ≥10× multipliers have decreased very significantly, multipliers between 2× and 6× have increased by a noticeable margin themselves.
So statistically speaking, even though the major payouts have become even more rare, players will experience the lower multiplier events more frequently than ever before.
document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧从统计角度看，尽管高额赔付更加罕见，玩家遇到低倍数事件的频率却会显著提高。⟦/R0⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.source: The default volatility profile has a fairly linear frequency curve for the 9 regular Symbols. However, this game is special in the sense that the regular Symbols are split into 2 distinct groups: 5 Low Symbols, and 4 High Symbols. This grouping matters because of the Bathala Symbol Elimination Skill, where a randomly selected Low Symbol is eliminated after a regular Symbol Win. High Symbols are not able to benefit from this elimination.
document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧默认波动性特征下，9 个普通符号的出现频率曲线较为线性。但本游戏将普通符号分成 2 个组别：5 个低赔符号和 4 个高赔符号。由于 Bathala 符号消除技能会在普通符号中奖后随机消除一个低赔符号，这一分组具有重要意义；高赔符号无法从该消除机制中受益。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧⟦R5⟧⟦/R5⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.source: Due of this exclusion, Low Symbols actually add more to engagement than High Symbols, simply because Eliminations from Low Symbols can trigger recursive wins.
document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧由于这一机制限制，低赔符号对玩家参与度的贡献实际上高于高赔符号，因为消除低赔符号可能触发后续连续中奖。⟦/R0⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.source: Therefore, one way to noticeably reduce volatility while maintaining engagement is to shift both symbol frequency weightage and payouts from High Symbols (H1H4) to Low Symbols (L1L5).
document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧因此，在保持玩家参与度的同时降低波动性的一种有效方法，是将符号出现频率权重和赔付额度从高赔符号（H1H4）转移至低赔符号（L1L5）。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧⟦R5⟧⟦/R5⟧⟦R6⟧⟦/R6⟧⟦R7⟧⟦/R7⟧⟦R8⟧⟦/R8⟧⟦R9⟧⟦/R9⟧⟦R10⟧⟦/R10⟧⟦R11⟧⟦/R11⟧⟦R12⟧⟦/R12⟧⟦R13⟧⟦/R13⟧⟦R14⟧⟦/R14⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.source: As a key point of note, the default H3 has a huge payout cliff. At (H3 x 8), the payout is 2.5× which then scales rapidly to 10× at (H3 x 10), and then 25× at (H3 x 12). For a basic mechanic, such exponential payouts are unnecessary. Therefore, my suggested paytable has reduced these to 2.5×, 4.5× and 10× respectively.
Similarly, the default L5 went from a payout of only 1.5× at (L5 x 10) to 10× at (L5 x 12). I have suggested reducing (L5 x 12) from 10× to just 4×.

In fact, I have compressed most of the payout cliffs from L3, L4, L5, H1, H2, H3, H4 which will help us to free up payout allocations to L1 and L2. So for example, the suggested payout at (L1 x 8) should increase by 60%. Performing these adjustments will materially reduce standard deviation.

In conjunction with higher payouts for Low Symbols, we can also improve their weight frequency. This will noticeably improve player experience because players will be able to see more 8-9 Symbol Wins, which could then lead to more Tumbles, more Symbol Eliminations, more Symbol Refills, and recursive wins thereafter.
document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧在提高低赔符号赔付的同时，还可以提高其出现权重。玩家将更频繁地看到 8-9 个符号组成的中奖，从而触发更多连消、符号消除、符号补充及后续连续中奖，显著改善核心体验。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧⟦R5⟧⟦/R5⟧⟦R6⟧⟦/R6⟧⟦R7⟧⟦/R7⟧⟦R8⟧⟦/R8⟧⟦R9⟧⟦/R9⟧⟦R10⟧⟦/R10⟧⟦R11⟧⟦/R11⟧⟦R12⟧⟦/R12⟧⟦R13⟧⟦/R13⟧⟦R14⟧⟦/R14⟧⟦R15⟧⟦/R15⟧⟦R16⟧⟦/R16⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.source: In fact, the frequency weights for Base Game Symbols and Free Game Symbols should be modified independently from one another as they impact RTP differently.
document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧基础游戏与免费游戏的符号出现权重应独立调整，因为两者对 RTP 的影响不同。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.source: For Base Game Symbols, I have intentionally shifted weightage from L4, L5, H1, H2, H3 and H4 in favor of L1, L2 and L3. Doing so increases the probability of triggering at least one ≥8 regular Symbol cluster from ~32% to ~49% using this distribution method.
At the same time, I have reduced the frequency of multipliers by about 40% (from 0.45% to 0.27%).
So as a result, instead of waiting for a multiplier event for engagement, the player will now expect:
document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧因此，玩家不再依赖等待倍数事件获得参与感，而会形成以下体验预期：⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧⟦R5⟧⟦/R5⟧⟦R6⟧⟦/R6⟧⟦R7⟧⟦/R7⟧⟦R8⟧⟦/R8⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.source: ≥8 REGULAR SYMBOL ➔ BATHALA ELIMINATION ➔ REFILL ➔ ≥8 REGULAR SYMBOL REACTIVATION
On the other hand, I would recommend making Free Game Symbol weightage premium-leaning. So for example, increase H1 from 9.0% to 13.6%, while increasing H2 from 7.5% to 10.9%.
This might create an interesting psychological effect where Free Games become perceived as a premium variant due to the frequency of High-Symbols.
document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧这可能形成一种有趣的心理感知：由于高赔符号出现得更频繁，免费游戏会被视为更高价值的游戏模式。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.source: Sim2 (Tumble-led) delivers a much more active core loop.
document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧Sim2（连消主导型）带来了活跃度显著更高的核心循环。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.source: Win Cadence rose from 31.3% to 45.6% and Tumbles increased from 34.7% to 49.1%, meaning players encountered continuation mechanics far more frequently.

document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧Sim2（连消主导型）对倍数的依赖显著降低。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.source: Multiplier RTP fell from 49.6% to 24.4%, so Sim2 shifts more of its payout value towards regular and tumble-driven outcomes instead of multiplier spikes.
document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.translation: ⟦R0⟧倍数 RTP 从 49.6% 降至 24.4%，说明 Sim2 将更多赔付贡献转移至普通中奖和连消驱动的结果，而非高倍数爆发。⟦/R0⟧⟦R1⟧⟦/R1⟧⟦R2⟧⟦/R2⟧⟦R3⟧⟦/R3⟧⟦R4⟧⟦/R4⟧⟦R5⟧⟦/R5⟧⟦R6⟧⟦/R6⟧⟦R7⟧⟦/R7⟧⟦R8⟧⟦/R8⟧⟦R9⟧⟦/R9⟧⟦R10⟧⟦/R10⟧

document.body.0000.tbl.0001.tr.0000.tc.0.source: CoV fell from 9.50 to 3.68, with Maximum Observed Win falling from 3,820× to 616×. This indicates a much narrower payout distribution, with fewer extreme tail outcomes and a more consistent player experience.
